tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// yul ris gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma stob pa'i cho ga yul bdag dgyes pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gang gi bka' lung mi dang mi min gyi// gtsug na 'bab stegs 'cha' ba bla ma dang*// gnyis min spyan ras gzigs dbang la btud de// yul bdag dgyes pa'i gtor ma stob tshul 'dri// de'ang dkar gtor rgyan ldan la 'bru sna ja phud bcas legs par bran la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma lha'i zhal zas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ bdag nyid yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi gzhi'i bdag po spyi dang khyad par dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gzhi bdag gi rgyal po mtho zil phram rdo rje g.yung drung*/ 'bri gnyen 'dong rdo rje blo gros la sogs pa mdo khams kyi ljongs so so la dbang sgyur ba'i lha klu 'byung por gtogs pa'i yul lha gzhi bdag gnyen po mched dang*/ rigs sras btsun mo blon 'bangs 'khor dang yang 'khor du bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gtor ma'i mgron du ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dang*/ lag pa g.yas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ sarba bhu mī pa ti sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ/ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta swā hā/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis bsngos/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig

/ces pas so sor thob par byas/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan 'dzad pa med pa'i phung po 'di nyid/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi gzhi'i bdag po spyi dang khyad par dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gzhi bdag gi rgyal po mtho zil phram rdo rje g.yung drung*/ 'bri gnyen 'dong rdo rje blo gros la sogs pa mdo khams kyi ljongs so so la dbang sgyur ba'i lha klu 'byung por gtogs pa'i yul lha gzhi bdag gnyen po mched dang*/ rigs sras btsun mo blon 'bangs 'khor dang yang 'khor du bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo// stob bo// bzhes shig rol cig 'jig rten skyong ba chen po khyed rnams/ sngon nas da lta'i bar du rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob chen po ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis mthun pa'i gtor mas brngan/ dam pa'i chos bshad/ bsgos pa'i bka' dang dam tshig gnyen po rjes su dran par byos la/ khyed rnams rang rang gis bsrungs pa'i sa phyogs yul gru gang dang gang yin pa de dang de dag tu/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa rin po che dang*/ bstan pa'i snang byed chen po rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mchog gi lugs bzang chos kyi snang ba chen pos rtag par khyab pa'i phrin las sgrubs shig de 'dzin chos kyi spyan ras yangs pa rnams kyi gsang gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin du brling ba dang*/ tshul khrims bslab ldan dge slong gi dge 'dun sen+dhū wā ra'i rgya mtsho g.yo ba lta bu 'dus pa'i khur chen pos sa steng kun du brgyan pa'i stong grogs bzang po mdzod cig bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams kyi sku tshe dang bsod nams mnga' thang dpal 'byor thams cad dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig 'jig rten gyi khams phyug cing lo legs pa dang*/ bde ba rgyu dang bcas pa la longs spyod pa'i skal ba can du bsgrub pa dang*/ bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam don thams cad gegs med yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las g.yel ba med par sgrubs shig

ces dang*/ spro na/ srid pa'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs sa srungs steng*// rdzu 'phrul mthu yi rtse mo brgya pa can// rnam 'dren bstan pa srung ba'i mel tshe yi// mig stong phrag lta ba'i gzhi bdag rnams la bstod// kun mkhyen bstan pa'i snang chen e waṃ pa'i// lugs mchog bshad dang sgrub pa lhur len pa'i// ngur smrig 'chang ba brgya stong grangs med kyis// nor 'dzin kun du mdzes pa'i stong grogs mdzod// mchod 'os mchod pa'i gus ldan sbyin bdag rnams// 'chi med tshe dang nyams med bsod nams stobs// 'dzad med dpal 'byor phun tshogs rnam thos bu'i// mnga' 'byor 'di na 'phos snyam nyid du mdzod// rang rang bsrungs pa'i sa phyogs kyis mtshon pa'i// yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde zhing lo phyugs 'phel// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor dbyar dus chu gter bzhin// bri med ches cher 'phel ba'i stong grogs mdzod// bdag cag yon sbyor bcas pa'i mi nor phyugs// gzhi byes 'gro 'dug gnas skabs thams cad du// nyes pa'i phyogs srungs bsam don gegs bral du// legs par grub pa'i stong grogs dpung gnyen mdzod// ces dang*/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las sogs nas sras su skye zhes pa'i bar gyis chos sbyin bya'o// 'dir 'khro zil phram rdo rje g.yung drung dang*/ 'bri gnyen 'dong rdo rje blo gros zhes pa'i tshab tu rang rang gi phyogs kyi gzhi bdag gi ming bsgyur ba'am mi shes na/ khyad par mdo khams kyi ljongs so so zhes pa dang sbrel bas gzhi bdag thams cad kyi gtor ma'i cho ga 'dis grub bo// gang ltar yang bsang mchod sogs cho ga gzhan dang ma 'brel ba'i tshe/ oṃ sarba bhū mī pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes pas mgron rnams rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam mo// 'jig rten skyong ba'i mgron rigs dgyes pa'i thabs// bgyis pa'i dge bas sbyin bzhi'i pha rol du// bde bar phyin pa'i go 'phang la gnas nas// 'gro rnams yang dag lam la bkri bar shog

/ces yul ris gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma stob pa'i cho ga yul bdag dgyes pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni mkhas btsun bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// srid pa'i lha 'dre 'byung po'i tshogs la bsgo ba'i chos gtam bdud rtsi'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru badz+ra dha rā ya// khams gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum// dbyer med lag na rdo rje nged kyi bkas// srid mtshor kun du rtog pa'i chu zla'i gzugs// shar ba'i lha 'dre 'byung por bsgo ba'i 'phrin// bslu med dkon mchog gsum po skyabs su zung*// 'gro ba kun la phan pa'i sems mchog skyed// sdig spang dge ba bsgrub pa'i spyod spyad na// sdug bsngal kun las grol 'gyur rgyal bas gsungs// deng 'dir rin chen chos dbang ltos 'khor bcas// rtag tu gnod pa'i bsam sbyor ring spangs nas// legs pa'i lam zhugs byang chub sgrub pa la// phan pa'i sems bcas zhi bar rnal du mnos// bdag dang gzhan gnyis sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang*// bde legs 'dod du mtshungs pa'i tshul soms la// gzhan gnod tsher ma'i dbal so mi gzings par// byams brtse'i 'bras ldan ljon pa'i yal ga rkyongs// gtan bde sgrub pa'i chos gtam bdud rtsi'i thigs// legs byin dge ba mi dang mi ma yin// phan tshun mnyes gshin ma bu ltar byams shing*// mthar thug thar pa'i grong mchog phyin rgyur bsngo// zhes srid pa'i lha 'dre 'byung po'i tshogs la bsgo ba'i chos gtam bdud rtsi'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ldan yul 'dam thog pa dge slong rin chen chos dbang can gyi ngor/ gsang bdag snyems pa ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba nas bris pa dge'o//

//na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ srid gsum dregs pa kun gyi thor tshugs rtser// bka' lung nor bu'i rgyan du gus len pa// bla ma yi dam mchog gsum srung mar bcas// kun 'dus he ru kar snyems bdag cag gis// sa gsum srid pa'i do ra yangs pa'i gzhir// kun rtog bden zhen 'khrul pa'i byed po yis// mngon par sprul pa'i 'jig rten lha 'dre zhes// gdon bgegs 'byung por gtogs pa khyed cag rnams// phan 'dod snying rje'i smyug gu bsgyur ba'i rtses// sgo ba'i 'phrin yig snying gar bkod pa 'di// dga' ba'i 'dzum zer dmul pas mnyen gyis dang*// 'phral yun bde rgyur 'gyur ba gor ma chag /skyabs gsum cod paṇa gtsug gi rgyan du chings// bzod pa dam pa snying gi nor bur chongs// chos mdzad yongs la phan grogs lhur bgyid na// sdug bsngal kun las grol 'gyur ston pa'i bka'// khyad par kun dga'i bstan la dad stobs ldan// sangs rgyas chos tshogs rgya mtsho skyabs bzung nas// de yi bslab byar slob pa zung dag gis// mar gyur 'gro don byang chub sgrub pa la// zag bcas mngon shes mig dang rdzu 'phrul mthu// nyung zad mnga' ba'i mi min 'byung po dag /nyes phyogs las bsrung legs pa brgyar sbyor ba'i// sman 'dogs sgrub pa'i stong grogs rtag tu gyis// de ldog sgo gsum dge bar sbyor ba la// phrag dog gdug sems nyer bcangs bar chad bgegs// las ngan goms shugs nyer 'tshe yid srub 'phrul// gang yang ma brtsam bde bar gnas su chug /rang gzhan bde rgyur sbyor ba'i mi 'gyur 'phrin// gdams 'dir phrag dog rgyud 'khrugs 'gal rkyen rigs// gang dag brtsams pa de la rgyal kun gyi// ye shes rdo rjes bcom phyir bag yod byos// gang la gsol btab mi bslu bden pa'i rnga// srid pa'i rtse mor lud pa'i dbyangs ldir ba// bden pa de yis mi dang mi ma yin// phan tshun byams pa'i mdza' bas bcing gyur cig

/srid par gnas skabs phan gnod byed pa po// 'jig rten lha 'drer chos min spong ba'i 'phrin// srid zhi'i khyab bdag snyems pa'i bzhad sgra 'di// tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris bi dza ya// zhes pa 'di'ang dge slong kun dga' stobs ldan dang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dag gi ngor bris pa'o// ༈ //na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ 'khor 'das stong nyid snying rjes mnga' sgyur ba'i// dgyes mdzad khrag 'thung rgyal por snyems pa dag gis// snang srid lha 'drer kun la bsgo ba'i 'phrin// gdong lnga'i nga ro bsgrags la rna ba lhogs// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin spros dang bral ba'i tshul// ji bzhin ma rtogs kun rtog smyug gu'i rtses// cir yang bris pa'i lha 'dre 'byung gdon zhes// snang zhing srid pa'i dregs pa khyed cag rnams// phan btags lan du rang la bde ba 'byung*// gnod byas lan du mi bde sdug bsngal kun// brag cha'i lad mo ltar 'byung shes gyis la// sems can yongs la phan pa'i sems mchog skyed// khyad par sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun bcas// skyabs su nges par bsten pa'i khyim bdag ni// tshe ring phun tshogs mi rgyud nor phyugs bcas// gzhir gnas byes bgrod gnas skabs thams cad du// gzhan gyi rbad dam rang nyid zhe sdang ba'i// kha rlangs nad gdon bgegs dang dus min 'chi'i// bar chad co 'dri'i rnam pa ma rtsom par// brtse zhing byams pas phan 'dogs stong grogs gyis// smras don 'gal na dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'// bden pas khyed cag mi bdar byed 'gyur mod// tshul bzhin bsgrubs na srid zhi'i bde dga'i dpal// gya nom spyod pa bden pa'i mthu yis so// skyabs mchog gsum gyis mi bslu'i bden pa dang*// chos nyid zab mo 'pho bral bden pa'i stobs// chos can rgyu 'bras bslu med rten 'brel mthus// smras don lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces lha 'dre'i tshogs la bsgo ba'i 'phrin yig gdong lnga'i nga ro zhes bya ba 'di ni/

dgon gsar tshe ring phun tshogs kyi ngor/ shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs nas bskur ba dge legs rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
